findings.citation: spec.md Testing decisions 3: "Then show the dashboard with the Client's name, the Tester's username, the right Active Fleet, Open Requests counting the Request whether it is at Pending Approval, Submitted or In Progress"
findings.note: The real-backend e2e never asserts the viewer chip's username and checks Open Requests only for a freshly submitted Request's status, not across Pending Approval, Submitted and In Progress.

findings.citation: ARCHITECTURE.md: "This file points; it never describes. A route, a schema, a function signature is read in the code, never copied here — a copy goes stale, a pointer does not."
findings.note: The new frontend/app/client/(dashboard) line copies routes ('reading /api/me/client and /api/me') and is already stale. Keep only the pointer.
On mobile the Contract row label truncates to 'Solstice R…', dropping the country, the only part that tells Contracts apart. Allow wrap / line-clamp-2.
frozenTotal repeats toResponse's frozen-total sum; one helper would define the ADR 0001 total once. (The spec reviewer raised the same.)
UNAVAILABLE element copied from components/agent/dashboard-stats.tsx; share one export.
loadClient and loadUsername repeat fetch, console.error, throw; the not-linked state repeats error.tsx's shell.

Adds a description the spec does not give ('Your Client and login could not be read.', passive). The design audit notes the copy structure is inconsistent with the region error ('Reload the page to try again.').
4 + 3xN backend reads through backendFetch without a timeout (Frontend 15 judgement; first-party backend; shared helper).
clientInvoiceStatusTone and clientInvoiceStatusLabel lost their only consumer; with the other demo-keyed maps, the @/lib/demo/types import now feeds only dead code.
Dark-mode 'Open Invoices' link 3.66:1 (known app-wide debt, the 'Open queue' entry); its target is ~18px tall on mobile.
The tokens are named 'label' but carry only the size; they are used for caption-like text too. Consider caption naming, or a DESIGN.md note.
No retry control (reset() unused); the spec copy says 'reload the page'.
The not-linked state uses the warning triangle, like the two failure states.
Full-page states double-frame (a dashed EmptyState inside a hairline Card), mirroring the Agent dashboard.
Degraded, empty, not-linked and error states have no screenshot goldens (text assertions only).
Straight apostrophes in user-facing copy (tests assert the straight form).
Indigo text link arguably a fourth indigo role beyond DESIGN.md's three; app-wide pattern, predates this branch.
Two indigo stat numbers per screen vs DESIGN.md 'the primary stat number'; StatCard's docstring reads it per card. Pre-existing.
Stat card label/value/meta are sibling spans, not dl/dt/dd (pre-existing).
No skip-to-content link app-wide (pre-existing).
Billing month uses a hard-coded en-US locale (pre-existing helper).
